content.text:
I changed the version selection in `InngestCommHandler.ts` so `optimizeParallelism: false` (on the function or the client) always runs the function as V1. I haven't run any tests, and I didn't add a test for the `version: 2` case.

The old code only applied the opt-out when the SDK had picked the version itself (`version: -1`). I removed that condition, so an explicit `2` in the request body no longer overrides it. The version that gets reported in the `x-inngest-req-version` header comes from the same variable. I didn't trace that path, so I haven't confirmed the header reads `1` in every case. Without the opt-out, behaviour is unchanged: V2, reported as `2`.

I also removed the `sdkDecided` variable from that method because nothing used it any more.

A type check of the package showed no errors in `InngestCommHandler.ts`. The errors it printed were all in `src/test/functions/`, mostly "cannot find module 'inngest'". I only looked at the first ten lines of output.
